name: Alchemix USD
oneLiner: alUSD is Alchemix's self-repaying CDP stablecoin: users borrow against DAI/USDC/USDT collateral and the yield from those deposits gradually repays the debt.
collateral: DAI, USDC, and USDT deposited into yield strategies (Yearn, Aave) via Alchemix CDPs; yield automatically repays debt
pegMechanism: Self-repaying loans: yield from deposited stablecoin collateral automatically repays debt; Transmuter guarantees 1:1 redemption

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: ALUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: alUSD is minted by the AlchemistV2 contract when users deposit DAI/USDC/USDT collateral; only whitelisted Alchemix contracts can mint the token, and the ALCX DAO (timelocked multisig) sets global mint limits and risk parameters.

controls.label: AlchemistV2 (whitelisted minter)
controls.capDescription: Per-synthetic global mint limit that linearly cools down over time; minting only against deposited collateral up to ~50% LTV.
controls.evidence: The alUSD token's setWhitelist/setBlacklist functions restrict minting to authorized Alchemix contracts; AlchemistV2 issues alUSD against deposited collateral within governance-set mint limits.

controls.label: Alchemix DAO timelocked multisig (parameter governance)
controls.evidence: ALCX-governed timelocked multisig configures mint limits, loss thresholds, and emergency Sentinel/Governance recall functions; it tunes parameters rather than minting directly.

review.evidence: Alchemix docs describe AlchemistV2 as the sole alUSD minter (token whitelist), with governance-set per-synthetic mint limits and ALCX DAO/timelock parameter control; no centralized direct-mint route exists outside the CDP contracts.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism and governance confirmed from Alchemix docs; on-chain owner/admin Safe internals and exact multisig threshold not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the live AlchemistV2 admin owner, the ALCX timelock/multisig threshold, and current mint-limit parameters on-chain.
